decision.title: 部署独占锁采用 POSIX 独占文件锁，Windows 生产 unsupported
decision.summary: POSIX single-host OS-level exclusive non-blocking file lock held by a persistent O_CLOEXEC fd until process exit (kernel releases on death); lock path is an absolute canonical owner-only no-follow single file outside the recovery domain; normal/recovery/requeue share one lock; any missing facility, unverifiable ACL, invalid path or failed acquisition exits with code 2 before any DB/CAS/file mutation, with no fallback and no degradation; file existence is not ownership and unlock does not delete the file; caller bool/no-op/fake forbidden. Windows production is unsupported (exit 2), only software contract and deterministic test doubles remain. O_EXCL lock file, PostgreSQL advisory lock, in-process mutex and no-lock are rejected.
